newsitem.title: UK: Atlantic Panamax rates again pressure BFI lower.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Panamax rates again pressure BFI lower.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) dropped a further 13 points on Wednesday to 1,475 as weaker Panamax rates in the Atlantic were again a negative influence.
Brokers said Dreyfus fixed Orjen from Mississippi to ARA range for end Nov at a lumpsum of $765,000, equivalent to $13.60 basis light grains.
This follows Tuesday's report of a weaker USGulf to Japan for mid-Dec at $23.00 no combination to Hanjin.

Preag were reported to have fixed 60,000 Richards Bay to Rotterdam for Dec 15/30 at a weaker $8.50. But brokers reported more enquiry today for Panamax grain and fertiliser shipments from USGulf for December loading.
Some Panamax fixtures in the Far East appeared to be slightly easier. Caper rates have remained barely steady.
BIFFEX eased by eight to 12 points with turnover at 1300 GMT totalling 120 lots.
